Battery Ventures makes investment in Curve Dental
Curve Dental, a cloud-based, dental practice management software provider, has secured an undisclosed investment from Battery Ventures, a U.S. venture capital firm. With the deal, Battery's Chelsea Stoner and Duncan Gills will join the board along with healthcare software executive Dave Cormack. Curve Dental, based in Calgary and Orem, Utah, said it plans to use the funds raised to accelerate growth, drive product innovation, and provide services to customers in the dental industry. The company may also undertake acquisitions. Founded in 2005, Curve Dental is led by President and CEO Ian Zipursky.
